Markets.title: Geraldine Weiss’s dividend strategy: The blue-chip investing formula that stood the 'Test of Time'
Markets.summary: Geraldine Weiss created a value-investing strategy focused on purchasing financially strong blue-chip stocks when their dividend yields exceeded historical norms. Her approach relied on consistent dividend growth, reasonable valuations, moderate debt, and patience to generate income and spot undervalued investments.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices ended lower last week amid range-bound trading and pressure in the broader markets. Analysts expect Nifty support between 24,200 and 24,230, with resistance set at 24,500 to 24,550 for the upcoming week.

Markets.title: What Shah Rukh Khan, Madhuri Dixit and Sachin Tendulkar see in Purple Style Labs IPO? Here’s what DRHP reveals
Markets.summary: Celebrity investors including Shah Rukh Khan, Madhuri Dixit, and Sachin Tendulkar have backed Purple Style Labs, the parent company of Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop. The luxury fashion retailer has received SEBI approval to launch an initial public offering of ₹660 crore by the end of August.

Markets.title: Still holding cash at home? Warren Buffett calls it oxygen, but says it’s not good as an asset
Markets.summary: Berkshire Hathaway reduced its large cash reserves to buy back shares and make strategic equity investments, including a major purchase of Alphabet stock. Despite this decrease in cash, the company reported strong increases in both quarterly operating profit and net income.

Markets.title: Big Bull's magic: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala turned Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight after the 1989 budget
Markets.summary: Following the 1989 Union Budget, 29-year-old investor Rakesh Jhunjhunwala defied widespread panic selling by betting that the government would pursue growth. His contrarian investment strategy turned Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight.

Markets.title: Mcap of five of top-10 most valued firms erodes by Rs 1 lakh cr; TCS takes biggest hit
Markets.summary: Five of India's ten most valuable firms lost a combined Rs 1 lakh crore in market capitalization last week, with Tata Consultancy Services taking the largest hit. Meanwhile, the remaining five top firms saw notable valuation gains, and Reliance Industries retained its spot as the country's most valuable company.

Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced plans to reduce U.S. military drills with South Korea. This decision follows South Korea's refusal to support the United States in the Iran conflict.

Geo-Political.title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian attack on Russia killed at least seven people, marking the largest strike of 2026. Simultaneously, Russian overnight strikes sparked fires across the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
Geo-Political.summary: Twin fires on the Greek island of Salamina have resulted in two deaths and the evacuation of hundreds of residents. Approximately 200 firefighters managed to contain one of the blazes while working to prevent the two fires from merging.

Geo-Political.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
Geo-Political.summary: Four rare Renaissance paintings were stolen overnight from an Italian museum without triggering the alarms. Authorities suspect the theft was carried out by professionals.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
Geo-Political.summary: An earthquake in Indonesia has killed at least 53 people and displaced thousands of residents. Hundreds of homes and public buildings suffered severe damage while rescue efforts continue.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for both primary articles and manufactured products increased during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst predictions and may provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

India.title: "One Family One Ticket" Row Grows As BJP's Ravneet Bittu Targets Congress
India.summary: BJP leader Ravneet Bittu has targeted the Congress party amid a growing internal dispute over the "One Family One Ticket" policy. This controversy has intensified the political conflict between Punjab Congress chief Amrinder Singh Raja Warring and Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa.

India.title: IPS Officer's Mother Found Murdered In UP Home, Jewellery Looted
India.summary: The mother of an Indian Police Service officer was found murdered inside her home in Ambedkarnagar, Uttar Pradesh. Jewellery was looted from the property during the incident.

India.title: Model Strips In Train Over Seat Spat, Attacks Railway Cop With Blade
India.summary: During a dispute over a seat on a train, a model stripped off her clothes and attacked a railway police officer with a blade. According to the Railway Protection Force, she also broke mobile phones and glasses during the altercation.

India.title: After NALSAR, Another Top Law College Opposes Invite To Chief Justice
India.summary: Students and alumni of NLSIU have criticized the Chief Justice of India's participation in their upcoming convocation. They released a letter expressing solidarity with NALSAR students who previously opposed a similar invitation, while also condemning the conduct of the Bar Council of India chairman.

India.title: Jharkhand Government Invites Student Protesters For Fresh Talks On Monday
India.summary: The Jharkhand government has invited student protesters for fresh talks on Monday. The decision followed a meeting between local officials and the students at their protest site in Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium.

India.title: Row Over 3 'Poachers' Shot Dead In Karnataka, Vijay Says They Were Tamils
India.summary: Actor Vijay rejected the Karnataka forest department's explanation regarding the fatal shooting of three men identified as poachers. He demanded a thorough investigation, stating that the victims were Tamils.
